additions.name: China Telecom Shaotang Campus Development

status.summary: City government records September 21 project commencement event. Ceremony supports announced project status; actual physical works stage is not independently established.

locator.precision: Reported center point of the campus 220kV substation in its northwest corner. Locates the campus through named on-campus support infrastructure; not a data-hall center, parcel centroid, or construction boundary.
locator.identity_review: Official EIA pages 3 and 17 name China Telecom Guangdong Shaotang data-center campus and GJ0202A-17A-1 parcel; page 18 explicitly places the proposed substation in the northwest corner of that data-center campus. Source geographic DMS 113 degrees 39 minutes 42.907 seconds east, 24 degrees 47 minutes 15.062 seconds north transcribed arithmetically to decimal degrees. Datum not stated; no WGS84 survey accuracy or CRS transformation asserted.
locator.uncertainty_reason: No positional accuracy or coordinate datum stated. Numeric precision is source transcription precision, not positional accuracy; offset to individual data halls is unknown.

additions.distinctness_review: Reviewed 414-project 2026-10-13-research dataset and all 231 original imported source records. Only existing Chinese project is China Mobile Haidong Phase2. No Shaotang/China Telecom/Shaoguan source entry. Shaotang is distinct from China Telecom Zhenjiang campus and other operators in Shaoguan.
additions.successor_review: Re-read September 22 government report of September 21 commencement; September 30 environmental approval relates only to the substation and does not upgrade data-center construction stage. No later verified building completion, operating or cancellation record found.
